localChanges: On the map, one of your cities in civil disorder now shows an unhappy citizen in place of its size, as in Civ1, until order is restored at the start of a turn (closes #193).

log: `subtract(Yield)` called `add` with the Yield's value, crediting the player. It now subtracts it, mirroring `add`. Both current callers pass a number, so play is unchanged. Adds the package's first tests, covering add, subtract and set with both forms (civ-clone/web-renderer#214).

The workflow from core-unit (Node 22, pnpm, compile check, tests) replaces the Node 12 npm one, `prettier:check` has `--check`, and `test` runs `tests/*.test.ts` with ts-mocha (civ-clone/web-renderer#66).
